novels.title: The Lantern Archive
novels.author: Sample Author
novels.premise: Alice Kim transfers to Vell Academy on a scholarship she never applied for. The academy's lanterns hold the memories of everyone who has carried them, and Alice is the only student who can read them.

novels.title: Night Shift at the Last Store
novels.author: Sample Author
novels.premise: After the Quiet empties the city overnight, store manager Alice Kim keeps her 24-hour convenience store open anyway. Her customers now include scavengers, a talking crow, and someone who only shops after 3 a.m.
